stop_contract.threshold_provenance: Retain v1.3 physical bands and confirmation, calibrate real low-energy control without changing bands to force PASS

entry_contract.low_energy_speed_scope: Full support-relative linear norm, not just lateral projection
entry_contract.stop_target_policy: For release/brake/low-energy only: spatial measurement target is COM at accepted stop onset, progress=0; no gameplay target or controller goal is written
entry_contract.revision_2_calibration: Development rev1 allowed stop motion .05 below settling .10, and one-hand low-energy had .145 total speed despite small lateral motion. Tighten entry semantics, preserve old receipts; never force a success.
entry_contract.support: Actual attached hands, no native ground authority; feet B1 measured separately
entry_contract.failure_policy: PRECONDITION_NOT_MET; never freeze or zero motion to obtain entry
entry_contract.revision_3_timing: Quiet preparation requires a full elapsed .25s between first and confirming quiet samples. Accepted-onset preconditions checked again, no pose/velocity writes.

comparison_contract.detection_scope: Serialization-scale divergence localization, NOT a calibrated physical equivalence tolerance
comparison_contract.critical_gate: No unexplained same-Hz catch outcome disagreement; valid setup, accepted tick commands, actual targets and contact chain required
comparison_contract.cross_hz: Compare event times and distributions; never require identical tick numbers or trajectories
comparison_contract.physical_acceptance_envelope: TO_BE_CHARACTERIZED_FROM_REPEATED_A0; absent calibration cannot certify search

future_search: BLOCKED until explicit reliability GO; no optimizer or private holdout access

clock_contract.startup: No Lab or measured world before two consecutive actual post-control callback deltas match requested Hz
clock_contract.fresh_world_creation: All first/subsequent worlds constructed at post_completed boundary after cleanup
clock_contract.during_episode: Any mismatched actual delta invalidates entire run; never replace or relabel it
